description: The Hill – Now in her fifth term in the Illinois House, Tony McCombie became the Prairie State’s first female House Republican leader in 2023. Before joining the state Legislature, McCombie served as mayor of Savanna, one of Illinois’s oldest towns. She’s a fierce critic of the corruption culture in Illinois, pushing for lobbying restrictions...

title: IL House GOP Leader McCombie Named One of the The Hills Top Women Shaping Policy - Tony McCombie for State Representative
